column1: # The user-facing surface B4 scans in the diff — must-match / must-not-match.
# S3.C.1 says a comparative claim "in the diff, PR body, docs, or benchmark output" must
# carry its comparator. Scanning EVERY changed path would red the very PR that adds this
# table, and would red a specification that quotes a banned ratio in order to ban it. The
# scope starts from the one check_no_claim_literals.sh already measured and defends —
# library and binary sources plus the book, never tests, benches, examples or fixtures,
# docs/**.md WAS IN THIS SCOPE AND WAS MEASURED OUT. Over the last 300 commits of
# origin/main the diff scan fires five times, on two commits, and three of the five QUOTE
# a fabricated claim in order to ban it — two of them in docs/benchmarking-gate-spec.md.
# Those three have no honest remedy: S3.C.1's exit is a comparator command, version and
# log, and there is no log for a number that was never measured. 2/5 is 40% measured
# precision against S7's >=90% admission bar, so the class may not block on that surface.
# The residual is recorded in the guard: a comparative claim added to docs/ prose is not
# blocked, and two real ones are named there.
